translations.translation: With the help of Heaven.
Shabbos Parshas Vayeishev,
Erev Rosh Chodesh Teves 5715*

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section introduces the phrase "Blessed is He who performed miracles for our forefathers" and questions the multiplicity and levels of miracles given their source above the chain of descent.

translations.translation: "Blessed is He who performed miracles for our forefathers, in those days, at this time."
And the Admur
(the Rebbe Rashab)
of blessed memory, explains in his maamar beginning with these words,
that "miracles" in the plural indicates
(in addition to many miracles,
also)
a multiplicity of types of miracles.
And it needs to be understood,
that the matter of multiplicity
(division)
is within the chain of descent,
and since the source of miracles is above the chain of descent,
as was explained earlier in the maamar beginning "Eliyahu opened"
that the source of the natural conduct is from the aspect of the chain of descent and the source of miracles is from above the chain of descent,
what is the matter of multiplicity
(division of levels)
in miracles?
Also, it needs to be understood what is explained in the aforementioned maamar at its conclusion in the interpretation of "miracles for our forefathers,"
that "our forefathers" are Chochmah and Binah,
and "miracle" (neis) is from the term "elevation" (neis), as in "I will raise a banner (neis),"
and the matter of "miracles for our forefathers" is an elevation and ascent in Chochmah and Binah.
And explanation is needed,
what is the matter of the ascent in Chochmah and Binah?
And also,
what is the connection of the elevation and ascent in Chochmah and Binah to miracles in their simple sense?

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the source of both natural and miraculous conduct is from the union of Chochmah and Binah, with the external union being the source of nature and the internal union being the source of miracles.

translations.translation: B)
And the point of the explanation in this matter,
that the source of the two conducts
(natural conduct and miraculous conduct)
is from the union of Chochmah and Binah,
for in the union of Chochmah and Binah there are two matters.
The external union of Chochmah and Binah,
for this union is constant
for the sake of the sustenance of the worlds,
and it is the source of the conduct of nature.
For since this union is for the sake of
(the sustenance of)
the worlds,
therefore the conduct of the world drawn from this aspect is that the Holy One, blessed be He, conducts the created beings in the world according to their matter,
each created being according to its characteristic and nature.
And the source of the miraculous conduct
[that the Holy One, blessed be He, conducts the world according to His will and not according to the characteristic and nature of the world]
is from the internal union of Chochmah and Binah.
And this is the connection of "miracles for our forefathers" to the interpretation that refers to the elevation and ascent of Chochmah and Binah with miracles in their simple sense
(a change of nature),
because the conduct of the world that is drawn from Chochmah and Binah as they are in their own essence
(including also as they unite in an external union)
is natural conduct,
and the drawing down of miracles
(a change of nature)
is through an elevation and ascent being made in Chochmah and Binah,
so that they unite in an internal union.
